AS - IS

Order processing staff check online orders one by one, An inefficient approach that processes orders and then forwards them to each system

  • During online order collection and OMS registration

    Requires unnecessary manual work

  • Due to insufficient time and staff

    Difficult to shorten the order processing cycle

  • Order confirmation, item-level processing, code matching, and more

    Requires complex manual Excel processing
TO-BE

Shoplinker automatically collects and processes orders, then sends them to each system, An efficient approach that handles tracking numbers in the same process

  • From collecting and processing orders from online malls to sending them to ERP / SAP

    Automate the entire process (skip the OMS step)

  • The logistics team directly in Shoplinker

    Tracking numbers can be generated and printed

  • Simplify the order processing workflow

    Save costs and time, reduce customer claims

FAQFrequently Asked Questions

  • Where can I find the APIs provided by Shoplinker?

    After you sign up for Shoplinker, we email you a webpage link. You can view the APIs on that page.

  • How do I integrate the API?

    You need an in-house developer or an external development company to integrate the API.

  • I want to integrate order features only.

    Use the order API to develop the fields and functions needed for order processing in your system.

  • I want to integrate product features only.

    Use the product API to develop the fields and functions needed to register and update products in your system.

  • Can I integrate my custom-built system with the Shoplinker API?

    Yes. Custom-built systems can integrate with a variety of APIs.

  • How long does API integration development usually take?

    For Shoplinker customers, development usually takes 4 to 8 weeks. It may take longer depending on the circumstances and the scope of API development.
